[LDET.2.1] Expanded:

| Input (must be identical) | Output (will be identical) |
|---|---|
| Compiled rule set (schemas + rules + manifests) | The full sequence of rule activations and their firing order |
| Event-trace event sequence (asserts / retracts / clock advances / adapter responses / adapter emits in exactly the same order at exactly the same clock instants) | The full sequence of facts asserted, retracted, and their slot values at every instant |
| Adapter-mock contract (same services, same responses to same correlation ids) | The full sequence of outgoing `call` actions with args and correlation ids |
| Starting engine state: its working memory and services at the first event, and its configuration ([LDET.2.7]). Its cache's starting entries are carried, not given: the host's seeds by the event trace's head ([RFCS.26.1]), the `initial` block's by the rule set ([LGRA.24.3]) | Every `cache-set` / `cache-get` / `log` / `emit` / `publish` and its payload |
| Platform signature — OS, CPU architecture, libc / libm, compiler toolchain | The full operator-log stream (`logical_assert`, `logical_retract`, activation lifecycle events) |
| | Engine state at every instant, observable via the introspection surface in TESTING and DEBUGGING |
